# Initialize rGEE and GEE

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
# Weird order I know but run this in it's entirety and it'll be fine
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("rgee_py", conda = "/opt/anaconda3/bin/conda", required = TRUE)
py_run_string("
import ee
ee.Initialize()
")
library(rgee)
ee_Initialize(drive = TRUE, project = "ee-gis712-2024", gcs = FALSE)
ee_clean_user_credentials()
ee_Authenticate()
library(reticulate)
use_condaenv("rgee_py", conda = "/opt/anaconda3/bin/conda", required = TRUE)
py_run_string("
import ee
ee.Initialize()
")
ee_Initialize(drive = TRUE, project = "ee-gis712-2024", gcs = FALSE)
```

# Earth Obervation Satellite Imagery download

```{r}
# Here I will download the satellite imagery that I will then use as the training data to
# help predict the wildfire risk potential
eeBWCA.shp <- sf_as_ee(BWCA.shp)
startDate <- "2024-06-01"
endDate <- "2024-09-01"

#----SENTINEL 2----#
# Band 1
# Read in the Sentinel-2 surface reflectance image collection which contains all the 
# images that we may want. Also ge the cloud band for masking purposes

# Load Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance and Cloud Probability collections
s2Collection <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)$
  filterBounds(eeBWCA.shp)$
  select("B1")
s2Clouds <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)

# Join SR and cloud collections by system:index
joinFilter <- ee$Filter$equals(leftField = "system:index", rightField = "system:index")
innerJoin <- ee$Join$inner()
joinedCol <- innerJoin$apply(s2Collection, s2Clouds, joinFilter)

# Cloud masking function (you must define this based on your needs)
# Example placeholder:
maskClouds <- function(joined) {
  sr <- ee$Image(joined$get("primary"))
  cloud <- ee$Image(joined$get("secondary"))
  cloudMask <- cloud$lt(10)  # Keep pixels with <10% cloud probability
  return(sr$updateMask(cloudMask))
}

# Apply cloud masking
sentinel2_band1_clean <- ee$ImageCollection(joinedCol$map(maskClouds))

# Optional: Resample to 30m and reproject to UTM Zone 15N (EPSG:26915)
resample30m <- function(image) {
  image$reproject(crs = "EPSG:26915", scale = 30)
}
sentinel2_band1 <- sentinel2_band1_clean$map(resample30m)

# Reduce across time to compute per-pixel percentiles (10th, 50th, 95th)
percentiles <- sentinel2_band1_clean$
  reduce(ee$Reducer$percentile(c(10, 50, 90)))$
  clip(eeBWCA.shp)$
  reproject(crs = "EPSG:26915", scale = 30)

# stats <- percentiles$select("B1_p50")$reduceRegion(reducer = ee$Reducer$minMax(), geometry = eeBWCA.shp, scale = 30, maxPixels = 1e13)$getInfo()
# print(stats)
# stats <- percentiles$select("B1_p10")$reduceRegion(reducer = ee$Reducer$minMax(), geometry = eeBWCA.shp, scale = 30, maxPixels = 1e13)$getInfo()
# print(stats)
# stats <- percentiles$select("B1_p95")$reduceRegion(reducer = ee$Reducer$minMax(), geometry = eeBWCA.shp, scale = 30, maxPixels = 1e13)$getInfo()
# print(stats)

# # Now you can use percentiles$select("B8A_p10"), "B8A_p50", or "B8A_p95" for display or export
# Map$centerObject(eeBWCA.shp)
# Map$addLayer(percentiles$select("B1_p50"),
#              list(min = 0, max = 16615, palette = c("black", "orange", "red")),
#              "Sentinel-2 B8A - 50th Percentile")
# 
# Map$addLayer(percentiles$select("B1_p10"),
#              list(min = 0, max = 16615, palette = c("black", "orange", "red")),
#              "Sentinel-2 B8A - 10th Percentile")
# 
# Map$addLayer(percentiles$select("B1_p95"),
#              list(min = 0, max = 16615, palette = c("black", "orange", "red")),
#              "Sentinel-2 B8A - 95th Percentile")

bandNames <- percentiles$bandNames()$getInfo()

for (band in bandNames) {
    image <- percentiles$select(band)$
    reproject(crs = "EPSG:26915", scale = 30)$
    clip(eeBWCA.shp)
    task <- ee_image_to_drive(image = image, description = paste0(band, "_export"), folder = "GEDI_BWCA", fileNamePrefix = band, region = eeBWCA.shp$geometry(), scale = 30, maxPixels = 1e13, fileFormat = "GeoTIFF"
  )
  cat("Starting export for:", band, "\n")
  task$start()
}

# Band 2
s2Collection <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_SR")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)$
  filterBounds(eeBWCA.shp)$
  select("B2")
s2Clouds <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)
joinFilter <- ee$Filter$equals(leftField = "system:index", rightField = "system:index")
innerJoin <- ee$Join$inner()
joinedCol <- innerJoin$apply(s2Collection, s2Clouds, joinFilter)
sentinel2_band2 <- ee$ImageCollection(joinedCol$map(maskClouds))
sentinel2_band2 <- sentinel2_band2$map(resample30m)
percentiles <- sentinel2_band2$

#----SENTINEL 1 SAR----#
# ASCENDING
# VH polarisation
# I downloaded the data using GEE and the script which can be found here (https://github.com/langoodall/Project-MN-Canopy-Fuels/blob/main/GEE.js)
# Uses and modified from Mullissa et al. (2021) https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13101954
# Here I am reading in the .tif files that I got from GEE and processing them

# So these are odd. The data is stored in linear which is great for the conversions and everything
# but needs to be in dB for plotting and comparison. To convert from linear to dB do the equation below
# dB = 10 * log10(x)
westBWCA_VH <- rast("/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/VH_p50-0000000000-0000000000.tif")
eastBWCA_VH <- rast("/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/VH_p50-0000000000-0000023296.tif")
stack <- sprc(list(westBWCA_VH, eastBWCA_VH))
VH <- mosaic(stack)
shapefile <- st_transform(BWCA.shp, crs = crs(VH))
VH <- crop(VH, shapefile) %>% mask(., shapefile)
VH <- project(VH, templateRaster, method = "near")
VH <- ifel(VH > 0, 10 * log10(VH), NA)
writeRaster(VH,
            filename = '/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/Processed Rasters/VH_p50.tif',
            datatype = "FLT8S",
            NAflag = 0,
            overwrite = TRUE)

# VV polarisation
westBWCA_VV <- rast("/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/VV_p50-0000000000-0000000000.tif")
eastBWCA_VV <- rast("/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/VV_p50-0000000000-0000023296.tif")
stack <- sprc(list(westBWCA_VV, eastBWCA_VV))
VV <- mosaic(stack)
shapefile <- st_transform(BWCA.shp, crs = crs(VV))
VV <- crop(VV, shapefile) %>% mask(., shapefile)
VV <- project(VV, templateRaster, method = "near")
VV <- ifel(VV > 0, 10 * log10(VV), NA)
writeRaster(VV,
            filename = '/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/Processed Rasters/VV_p50.tif',
            datatype = "FLT8S",
            NAflag = 0,
            overwrite = TRUE)

#----JAXA PALSAR----#
HV <- rast('/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/Processed Rasters/HV_BWCA_PALSAR_2024.tif')
HH <- rast('/Users/louisgoodall/Desktop/Portfolio_Projects/GEDI/Data/Processed Rasters/HH_BWCA_PALSAR_2024.tif')

gc()

plot(HV)
plot(HH)

HH %>% min()
HH %>% min()
HV %>% min()
HV %>% min()

ifel(HH > 0, 10 * log10(HH), NA) %>% min()
ifel(HV > 0, 10 * log10(HV), NA) %>% min()
ifel(HV > 0, 10 * log10(HV), NA) %>% min()
ifel(HH > 0, 10 * log10(HH), NA) %>% min()


plot(ifel(HV > 0, 10 * log10(HV^2) - 83, NA))
plot(ifel(HH > 0, 10 * log10(HH^2) - 83, NA))



x <- ifel(HV > 0, 10 * log10(HV^2) - 83, NA) %>% as.data.frame() %>% drop_na()

hist(x$HV, breaks = 100)

?hist
```

# Old SAR stuff

```{r}
#----SENTINEL 1 SAR----#
# ASCENDING
# VH polarisation
# Here I am downloading the Sentinel-1 SAR data for the BWCA. I will choose the ASCENDING
# data because to use both ASCENDING and DESCENDING requires more processing. So, for now,
# I will use one direction consistently
s1VHCollection <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S1_GRD")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)$
  filterBounds(eeBWCA.shp)$
  filter(ee$Filter$eq("instrumentMode", "IW"))$
  filter(ee$Filter$listContains("transmitterReceiverPolarisation", "VH"))$
  filter(ee$Filter$eq("orbitProperties_pass", "ASCENDING"))$
  select("VH")

maskEdges <- function(img) {
  edge <- img$lt(-30)
  img$updateMask(edge$Not())
}

s1VHCollection <- s1VHCollection$map(maskEdges)

percentiles <- s1VHCollection$
  reduce(ee$Reducer$percentile(c(10, 50, 90)))$
  clip(eeBWCA.shp)$
  reproject(crs = "EPSG:26915", scale = 30)

bandNames <- percentiles$bandNames()$getInfo()

for (band in bandNames) {
  image <- percentiles$select(band)$reproject(crs = "EPSG:26915", scale = 30)$clip(eeBWCA.shp)
  task <- ee_image_to_drive(image = image, description = paste0(band, "_export"), folder = "GEDI_BWCA", fileNamePrefix = band, region = eeBWCA.shp$geometry(), scale = 30, maxPixels = 1e13, fileFormat = "GeoTIFF")
  cat("Starting export for:", band, "\n")
  task$start()
}

###########################################

s1VH <- ee$ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S1_GRD")$
  filterDate(startDate, endDate)$
  filterBounds(eeBWCA.shp)$
  filter(ee$Filter$eq("instrumentMode", "IW"))$
  filter(ee$Filter$listContains("transmitterReceiverPolarisation", "VH"))$
  filter(ee$Filter$eq("orbitProperties_pass", "ASCENDING"))$
  select("VH")

s1VH$size()$getInfo()
s1VH$aggregate_array("system:id")$getInfo()

maskEdges <- function(img) {
  img$updateMask(img$gt(-30))
}
s1VH <- s1VH$map(maskEdges)

toLinear <- function(img) {
  ee$Image(10)$pow(img$divide(10))$copyProperties(img, img$propertyNames())
}
s1VH <- s1VH$map(toLinear)

leeFilter <- function(img) {

  # 3x3 kernel
  kernel <- ee$Kernel$square(1)

  # Local mean and variance
  mean <- img$reduceNeighborhood(ee$Reducer$mean(), kernel)
  variance <- img$reduceNeighborhood(ee$Reducer$variance(), kernel)

  # Noise variance (estimated locally)
  noiseVar <- variance$reduceNeighborhood(
    reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
    kernel = kernel
  )

  # Lee filter coefficient
  b <- variance$subtract(noiseVar)$divide(variance)

  # Filtered image
  mean$add(
    b$multiply(img$subtract(mean))
  )$rename(img$bandNames())$
    copyProperties(img, img$propertyNames())
}



lee_gee <- function(img, L = 1, win = 3) {

  kernel <- ee$Kernel$square(
    radius = win %/% 2,
    units = "pixels",
    normalize = TRUE
  )

  mean <- img$reduceNeighborhood(
    reducer = ee$Reducer$mean(),
    kernel = kernel
  )

  variance <- img$reduceNeighborhood(
    reducer = ee$Reducer$variance(),
    kernel = kernel
  )

  sigma_n2 <- 1 / L

  k <- variance$
    subtract(mean$pow(2)$multiply(sigma_n2))$
    divide(variance)$
    clamp(0, 1)

  mean$add(k$multiply(img$subtract(mean)))
}
```

```{r}
# Phenology Start of Season
# Because we only need the one image of yearly phenology, we can do the cloud masking
# a bit differently than previous cloud masking in this script. First let's make a
# function that masks clouds in MODIS
maskMODISClouds <- function(image) {
  qa <- image$select("QA_Overall_1")
  qualityMask <- qa$bitwiseAnd(3)$eq(0)   # Keep only the good cells
  image$updateMask(qualityMask)
}
```
